Japan.summary: At least 2,000 people have been stranded in flood-hit regions of Japan, amid warnings of further rain. Emergency services have rescued over 3,500 people. (Source: BBC, 16 Jul 2024)

The Japan Meteorological Agency has issued a warning about heavy rain hitting western Japan, which is expected to continue until Tuesday. The rain has disrupted train services. (Source: Japan Today, 17 Jul 2024)

Japan’s nuclear regulator has said that radioactive water leaks were detected at a Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant, with <10% of it containing radioactive substances. (Source: Kyodo News, 21 Jul 2024)
